source.basis: A reader's outline and the credited Comic Book Herald guide, adapted by the project; the guide is not asserted to supply every selected optional retelling or every exact placement.

source.licensing: Factual identities and project-selected ordering only. No source prose, branding, layout, image bytes, or permission grant is asserted.
source.sourceRetrievedAtStatus: The coordinator read the Claremont article on this date; this lane did not fetch it.

source.sourceRowsScope: These rows describe the project-selected checklist positions, not a transcription of the credited article. Earlier published positions and annual-placement evidence are identified separately.

relationshipReview.rationale: Approve the 258-position project-curated era, including 246 original positions in the same relative order and the twelve selected annual slots. relationshipReview.scope: V4 source, joint placement and the exact reciprocal relationships. Does not approve a historical replay, link refresh, later generated bytes or delivery.
